g.text: no request body and exactly one credential pair
verify controlled root and symlink boundary
Before commit, a failure does not expose session_id.
After commit, state is idle and no MessageEntry or AgentSession exists.
AgentSession is initialized lazily by the first user event.
The response contains only Session identity, current defaults,
This operation has no Idempotency-Key or If-Match.
Every successful POST creates a new Session.
A lost successful response can produce an orphan Session,
which background timeout cleanup must remove if unbound.
